title: Direct shared database access
reason: Direct database access crosses medication, consent, audit, and identity boundaries.

title: All-synchronous versioned API integration
reason: Synchronous API integration avoids shared tables but creates latency risk.

title: Patient Identity Gateway + Consent Boundary + Event/API layer
reason: Gateway/event design localizes identity, consent, audit, and DDI responsibilities.

title: Strangler migration with interim adapter
reason: Strangler adapter is safe but carries higher migration complexity.
